description: Recommends four-year pilot funding for SREDA's Business Hub.
Funded from Property Realization Reserve; other requests to budget.
Explore SREDA, Discover Saskatoon governance reforms by Q3 2026.

chips.text: The Centralized Business Hub aims to help local businesses navigate city processes.
Dale Botting, a citizen and former SREDA CEO, suggested more creative funding options.

speakers.name: Erin Lawson
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Economic Development Funding in Saskatoon
said: Proposal does not include incentives or civic policy tools.
Low unemployment challenges hiring and attracting new investment.
Proposes talent attraction/retention strategy to meet workforce needs.

speakers.name: Dale Botting
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Economic Development Funding
said: Current debate is too narrow; suggests more creative options.
SREDA should explore more own-source revenues, like membership growth.
Province of Saskatchewan should increase its economic development contribution.
